|strategy=By [mailto:bobafett@powerup.com.au Michael Sharp], Gold 29<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20020612232028/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/grandmofftarkin.html</ref>

For anyone thinking of having [[Darth Vader]] in their decks, be sure to include [[Grand Moff Tarkin]] as well!

Not only is he power 4 (helpful no matter how you look at it), but when you team [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] and [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] up in a battle, you can cancel one of your opponents destiny draws!

Combos:

[[Grand Moff Tarkin]] + [[Vader's Cape]] - Deploy this on [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] to give him immunity to attrition &lt;5 and the ability of adding +1 to each battle destiny.
|rulings=* May cancel any type of destiny such as battle destiny, weapon destiny, [[Sense (Dark){{!}}Sense]] destiny, etc.<ref name="scomp" />
* May cancel a duel destiny (if the duel takes place during a battle where [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] is with [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]).
* This card is not a commander ('commanded' doesn't count).
|combos=* [[Grand Moff Tarkin]] + any [[Darth Vader]] persona<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Grand%20Moff%20Tarkin</ref>
